Name: Clean Up Stardew Valley - Trash Nets
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=3][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

Feel like you're not doing enough to clean up the valley from trash and debris? Want to do the Community Cleanup Special Order but have the Mariner profession? This mod is for you!

Features:

- Adds a special net specifically for collecting trash, obtainable at Fishing Level 3
- It can be crafted or bought from Willy's shop
- Placeable in any outdoor body of water
- Works with Automate and trash added by mods!


Install:

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url].
- Copy [CP] Clean Up Stardew Valley into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!


Disclaimer: The design for the Trash Net was inspired by the Crab Pots from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables[/url]. No assets from that mod were used to create this one.
